validated_fix: src/ui/components/canvas_js_resize.py — pointer-down baseline seeded from live bounding box instead of stale node.style('width'/'height')

test_1_nested_container_constrained_resi.description: Select nested container; drag SE handle inward until clamp engages; measure drift

precondition.note: Old code would read 250px as baseline; new code reads 113px from live BB

test_1_nested_container_constrained_resi.analysis: Style correctly reduced from live BB (113→112), not from stale style (250→249). 1px drift matches the 1px drag exactly — no baseline-error jump.

test_2_nested_inward_clamp_hold.description: Drag SE handle far inward (62px+) past child boundary; verify clamp holds and no large drift
test_2_nested_inward_clamp_hold.action: SE handle drag from (1112,504) to (1050,445) — 62px inward
test_2_nested_inward_clamp_hold.analysis: Clamp held at content minimum (103×116). Drift ≤3px vs the ~97px the stale baseline would have caused.

test_3_parent_container_constrained_resi.description: Select parent container; drag SE handle inward until clamp engages
test_3_parent_container_constrained_resi.action: SE handle drag from (1146,535) to (1040,435) — 106px inward
test_3_parent_container_constrained_resi.analysis: Both NW and SE corners shifted by the same amount (~7px) — this is a symmetric Cytoscape compound-node center reflow (pure translation), NOT resize-baseline drift which would shift only one side. Observed 7px << expected pre-fix drift of 235px for original 400×300 style on 165×182 rendered node.

test_4_reload_persistence.description: Reload topology page; verify post-resize dimensions and hierarchy survive

post_reload_node_states.integrity: OK — post-resize style value (112px from live-BB drag) survived reload

key_evidence.mechanism_description: Old code read node.style('width'/'height') as resize baseline on pointerdown. For compound nodes whose actual rendered size is smaller than their style (because children constrain them), this produced a large error. New code reads the live bounding box via renderedBoundingBox(), which reflects the true rendered size.

remaining_observations.observation: Parent container shows 7-8px symmetric translation after constrained clamp drag
remaining_observations.cause: Cytoscape.js compound node center recalculation when style < child extent. Both NW and SE corners shift equally (pure translation). This is NOT the HT-050 drift bug — it is inherent Cytoscape reflow behavior on compound node re-anchor.
remaining_observations.actionable: Could be a follow-up investigation but does not represent the user-reported drift bug.

overall_verdict: FIXED — The constrained-container resize drift caused by stale node.style('width'/'height') baseline on pointer-down is eliminated. Live bounding box is now used as the baseline, producing accurate resize deltas and preventing large positional jumps.
